exit: 0
--- stdout
keywords:
  sequence extends none param in out block true false Real Integer Boolean

types:
  Real Integer Boolean

tags:
  @unit @quantity @displayUnit @brick @s223 @qudt @haystack @name @label @provisional

base units:
  m kg s A K mol cd rad sr Hz N Pa J W C V F Ohm S Wb T H lm lx Bq Gy Sv kat

parse codes (text form, exit 2):
  not-utf8              the input is not UTF-8
  byte-order-mark       the input starts with a byte-order mark
  control-character     a tab, carriage return, other control character or bidirectional override
  input-too-large       the input is larger than 4 MiB
  too-many-lines        the input has more than 100,000 lines
  line-too-long         a line is longer than 8,192 bytes
  token-too-long        a name, number, suffix, atom or provenance id is longer than 256 bytes
  string-too-long       a string is longer than 4,096 bytes as written
  comment-too-long      a comment is longer than 8,189 bytes after its #
  nesting-too-deep      lists nest deeper than 2
  too-many-statements   more than 65,536 statements of one kind or assignments in one block
  unterminated-string   a string has no closing quote on its line
  bad-escape            a backslash escape other than \", \\ or \n
  malformed-number      a number with a leading + or zero, a bare dot, an empty exponent or glued letters
  integer-out-of-range  an integer outside the 64-bit signed range
  non-finite-number     NaN, inf or Infinity as a value, or a real that overflows binary64
  malformed-suffix      a unit suffix that is not a unit expression
  unit-not-base         a unit suffix that is not built from base SI units
  malformed-atom        a tag atom or provenance id with a byte outside printable ASCII
  stray-token           a token where the grammar allows none, or a missing one
  unknown-keyword       a line that starts with no statement keyword and is not a connection
  unknown-tag           a boundary tag the grammar does not name
  duplicate-tag         a boundary tag other than @haystack written twice on one statement
  unknown-type          a type other than Real, Integer or Boolean
  missing-sequence      the file does not start with a sequence statement
  missing-extends       the sequence statement is not followed by an extends statement
  misplaced-statement   a second sequence or extends statement
  misplaced-value       a reference or a list as a sequence parameter's value
  malformed-list        an empty, ragged or mixed list
  unclosed-bracket      a ( or [ that is never closed
  comment-before-close  a comment after the last item of a (...) or [...]

finding codes, stage 1 (exit 1):
  empty-sequence               the sequence has no blocks
  invalid-name                 a declared name is not an identifier, or is a reserved word or keyword
  duplicate-name               a name is declared twice across parameters, inputs, outputs and blocks
  class-not-found              a block's class path is not a registered class
  class-not-authorable         a block's class is an engine-reserved lowering identity
  unknown-parameter            an assignment names no parameter of the block's class
  parameter-not-settable       an assignment names a parameter no author may set
  duplicate-parameter          a block assigns one parameter twice
  missing-required-parameter   a required parameter is not assigned
  parameter-kind-mismatch      a value's kind does not fit the parameter
  parameter-out-of-range       a value breaks a catalog rule, widths included
  non-finite-parameter         a Real value is NaN or infinite
  unknown-enum-literal         an enumeration member is not a member of the parameter's type
  unknown-parameter-reference  a reference names no sequence parameter
  malformed-connection         a connection endpoint is not name or block.port
  unknown-source               a connection source is neither a boundary input nor a block output
  unknown-target               a connection target is neither a boundary output nor a block input
  unknown-port                 a connection names a port the configured block does not have on that side
  invalid-semantic-point       a semantic, quantity or displayUnit field is malformed
  invalid-provenance-id        the extends provenance id is malformed
  single-assignment            two connections drive one block input or boundary output

finding codes, stage 2 (exit 1; engine codes pass through as well):
  document-too-large  the emitted document is larger than the engine loads
  load-failed         the throwaway engine refused the emitted document

wire codes (exit 2):
  not-utf8              the bytes are not UTF-8
  byte-order-mark       the document starts with a byte-order mark
  input-too-large       the document is larger than 4 MiB
  nesting-too-deep      objects and arrays nest deeper than 8 levels
  list-too-long         a list has more than 65,536 entries
  string-too-long       a string is longer than 4,096 bytes
  duplicate-key         an object repeats a key
  non-finite-number     NaN or Infinity as a number, or a real that overflows binary64
  integer-out-of-range  an integer token outside the 64-bit signed range
  control-character     a string carries a control character
  unknown-key           an object carries a key its schema does not define
  missing-key           an object lacks a required key
  wrong-type            a value has the wrong JSON type or an unknown enumerator
  json-syntax           the document is not JSON
  malformed-connection  a connection is not `source -> target` with exactly one ->
  wire-refused          a wire refusal this version of oce does not name

error codes (exit 2):
  missing-from        stdin (-) was given without --from text|wire
  unknown-form        the extension is neither .oce nor .json and --from was not given
  not-found           the input path does not exist
  not-a-file          the input path is a directory or another non-file
  read-failed         the input could not be read
  input-too-large     the input is over its form's 4 MiB limit; refused before it is read
  invalid-namespace   --namespace is empty, too long, not printable ASCII or does not end in #, / or :
  unspellable         the model cannot be written as text
  write-failed        the output could not be written or renamed into place
  write-needs-file    --write or -o cannot rewrite stdin
  write-needs-text    fmt --write rewrites text files only; redirect a wire file's text instead
  malformed-param     a --param is not NAME=VALUE
  unknown-param       a --param names no parameter of the class
  duplicate-param     a --param names one parameter twice
  malformed-value     a --param value is not of the parameter's type
  ports-unresolvable  the facade could not name the ports of an accepted table
  emit-refused        the emitter refused for a reason this tool does not know

exit codes:
  0  yes: clean, canonical, resolved
  1  no: an error finding, a non-canonical file, ports that do not resolve
  2  error: a usage, read, parse, size or I/O failure; the question was not answered

enumerations: not yet published by the facade (issue #468); see the crate README
--- stderr
